reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited paragraphs support it: compensation is time-and-materials plus actual expenses (p0013), and both termination clauses (p0033, p0044) limit Company's payment to fees/expenses actually incurred or earned through termination — an accrued-amounts formulation, not a stipulated or liquidated sum.

No liquidated damages, penalty, minimum-commitment, or early-termination fee payable by Customer appears in the quoted text; the liability provision (p0035) caps rather than creates Customer-payable damages, so the preferred position (no Customer-payable LDs) is met.

No redline or counterparty comment is expected for a compliant finding, and none was proposed; deterministic checks are empty and the original and rendered text are identical, consistent with a no-edit compliant record.
